intro:
Public Transport Simulator 2021 is an immersive simulation browser game developed by GameMonetize that allows players to experience the thrill of driving a bus through various cities and landscapes. As the name suggests, this game simulates the real-life experience of driving a public bus, complete with realistic maps, detailed bus vehicles, and an engaging gameplay mechanic. What sets Public Transport Simulator 2021 apart from other simulation games is its attention to detail and its ability to make players feel like they're actually driving a real bus. From the realistic bus sound effects to the detailed bus interiors, this game is a treat for simulation enthusiasts.

   The game's core premise is to transport passengers from one city to another, following traffic rules and earning money in the process. Players can customize their bus with various liveries, horns, telolets, bumpers, and velgs, making it stand out from the crowd. The game also features a unique STROBE Light that can be installed on the bus, making it the center of attention. The game's realistic maps, detailed buses, and wonderful interiors make players feel like they're driving a real bus. With its engaging gameplay mechanic and realistic features, Public Transport Simulator 2021 is a must-play for simulation enthusiasts.

   What's more, the game's features are extensive, including realistic maps, detailed buses, bus STROBE Lights, realistic bus driving experience, bus customization, open/close door button, animated people entering/exiting the bus, weather conditions, day/night cycle, steering wheel, buttons or tilt controls, various camera angles, detailed bus interiors, intelligent AI and traffic system, tons of AI vehicles variations, realistic traffic rules, realistic bus sound effects, and achievements and leaderboards. With so much to offer, Public Transport Simulator 2021 is a game that will keep players engaged for hours on end.

   In this review, we'll take a closer look at the game's core gameplay mechanics, what makes it addictive, its visual style and atmosphere, beginner tips and tricks, advanced strategies, game modes and features, and who should play this game. We'll also provide a final verdict on the game's replayability and who it's perfect for.

sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanic of Public Transport Simulator 2021 is to transport passengers from one city to another, following traffic rules and earning money in the process. Players can choose their bus route, which can range from short distances to longer routes, and earn money by transporting passengers. The game also features a realistic traffic system, where players must follow traffic rules, such as stopping at red lights and yielding to pedestrians. The game's AI system is intelligent, with AI vehicles that follow traffic rules and interact with the player's bus. Players can also customize their bus with various liveries, horns, telolets, bumpers, and velgs, making it stand out from the crowd.

      One of the unique features of the game is the STROBE Light that can be installed on the bus, making it the center of attention. The game also features a realistic bus driving experience, with realistic bus sound effects and detailed bus interiors. Players can also open and close the bus door, and animated people will enter and exit the bus. The game's weather conditions and day/night cycle add to the realism, making the game feel more immersive. The game's steering wheel, buttons or tilt controls, and various camera angles also add to the realism, making players feel like they're actually driving a real bus.

      The game's features are extensive, including achievements and leaderboards, which add a competitive element to the game. Players can compete with their friends to earn the most money, transport the most passengers, and complete challenges. The game's realistic traffic rules and intelligent AI system make it a challenging game, but also rewarding. With its engaging gameplay mechanic and realistic features, Public Transport Simulator 2021 is a must-play for simulation enthusiasts.
